support_tickets.title: Double charged in March 2026 - requesting immediate refund
support_tickets.description: Customer was charged twice on March 1, 2026 for their Professional Plan subscription. Both transactions of $299.00 were processed within hours of each other (00:00 and 14:37 UTC). Customer noticed the duplicate charge on their credit card statement and contacted support on March 8. They are frustrated and requesting an immediate refund of $299.00. Billing team has confirmed the duplicate transaction in the payment processor logs.

support_tickets.title: Request for updated invoice for Q1 2026
support_tickets.description: Customer requested corrected invoices for Q1 2026 to reflect only one charge per month, for their accounting records. Waiting on billing dispute resolution before issuing corrected documentation.

crm_notes.content: Customer called in on March 8 very frustrated about the duplicate charge. They mentioned they've been a loyal customer for over a year and expect better from us. Escalated immediately to billing team. Apologized and assured them a refund would be processed within 5-7 business days.
crm_notes.author: customer-success

crm_notes.content: Billing team confirmed duplicate transaction ID in Stripe. Root cause appears to be a webhook retry event that triggered a second invoice. Engineering has been notified to patch the idempotency issue. Refund of $299.00 has been initiated and should appear within 3-5 business days.
crm_notes.author: billing-team

crm_notes.content: Follow-up call scheduled for March 20 to confirm refund receipt and rebuild customer trust. Consider offering a courtesy discount on next month's invoice as a goodwill gesture.
crm_notes.author: customer-success
